name: self_coder
description: Autonomous self-improvement of the app's own CODE. Signals (debugger findings, failed turns) become Aider-edited branches that are verified (compile + boot + optional tests) before they can land. Core changes need human approval; small plugin-only changes can auto-merge. Canary deploy auto-rolls-back if the app doesn't come up. Disabled by default.

settings.label: Run full pytest in verify (slow but safer)
